chunk: Larry Barrett was born on February 4, 2001, in Ontario, Canada. Growing up, he was a shy and introverted child, often finding solace in his love for water polo and puzzle solving. His parents, both music enthusiasts, encouraged his musical talents, and he began taking piano lessons at the age of 6. As he grew older, Larry's passion for music only intensified, and he went on to study music theory and composition at a local conservatory.
